why: Training-cell OOF selection drove the switch threshold to the grid edge (tau*=40, OOF MAE monotone decreasing 3.208 at tau=8 to 2.480 at tau=40), i.e. training data rejects slope extrapolation. On C3 the frozen rule changes overall cell-macro MAE by -0.015 weeks (CI [-0.046, 0.000]) versus the tree: no gain. The tau=12 C3 tail improvement (32+ bucket 11.92 -> 9.17) does not reproduce on OOF and is therefore a C3-specific artifact, not a mechanism.
closed_direction: Slope-based crossing-time extrapolation for the long-RUL tail.
preserved_negative_result: All variants (F3/P1/P3 calibration/M2) underestimate the 32+ bucket by about 11 weeks; this is a data/information limit under the current as-of features, not a tuning problem.
next_candidates: Look for identifiable long-life information in training data (early coulombic efficiency / temperature / protocol group), with a fresh GO and a strong simple control.
Or make the honest failure boundary explicit: report a lower-bound/interval for 32+ week predictions and present the tail as a documented limitation rather than a solved case.
